message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"Precision reduction from 15 to 14 already showed a large SQNR drop (85.1 to 78.7 dB) for only a modest area saving, and symmetric_preadd at the same precision gives much lower area with identical numerical quality. Since switch_architecture and increase_precision have no legal unvisited neighbors, decreasing precision is the only available action, but it is likely to further degrade numerical quality."}
